facts.fact: Levellers says Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection is a standalone data law that becomes enforceable after an 18-month grace period ending 23 June 2026.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Levellers says the law creates a Personal Data Protection Authority that had not been created by presidential decree or made operational as of mid-2026.
Levellers says implementing regulations under Law No. 2024/017 were still expected as of mid-2026.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection
